title: Spare Cushion Units for Time Without the Fitting Item (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Rule.** Spare units are added to a no-charge reship of the fitting cushion item in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program for the time the patient went without the fitting item, counted in days from the day the fitting item's earlier supply ran out to the handling day:

- **two units** for 60 days or more;
- **one unit** for 30 to 59 days;
- otherwise none.

The spare units are added to the units after the monthly rate has been applied and before rounding to the nearest whole unit.

## Counting the days

The fitting item's earlier supply ran out on the covered-through date of the fitting cushion item's latest coverage-billed line. Days are calendar days from that date to the handling day. Where the enrollment has no coverage-billed line of the fitting item, or that supply is still running on the handling day, no days are counted and no spare unit is added.

## Boundary table (hypothetical dates, handling day 30 June)

| Earlier supply ran out | Days without | Spare units |
|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 60 | 2 |
| 2 May | 59 | 1 |
| 31 May | 30 | 1 |
| 1 June | 29 | 0 |
| still running on 30 June | — | 0 |
